en: A black-and-white postcard view over a European city from an elevated hillside. In the right foreground stands a small historic chapel-like building with arched windows and ivy on its walls, beside stone terraces, a path, and a small turreted structure. Below and to the left stretches a dense townscape of multi‑storey buildings along a river, with industrial facilities and chimneys visible further back. Low hills or mountains form the background. Along the bottom border there is a handwritten-style German caption.
